explanation.headline: Valacyclovir hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale General has 16.4 days on hand and the current label traces to a repack plant last inspected VAI 2025-09-26

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include valacyclovir hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 256 tablets of the 1 g presentation, which at 15.6 tablets per day provides 16.4 days on hand.
The product label (NDC 51655070304) names Northwind Health Company, LLC as the repack plant (FEI 1831143) with a last inspection classification of VAI on 2025-09-26.
FDA inspection records for FEI 1831143 show a VAI classification on 2025-09-26 (inspection 1256379) and an earlier OAI classification on 2015-12-09 (inspection 952157).

The top-ranked buying option is Aurobindo Pharma Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list and operates three plants: APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED (VAI 2025-12-17), Aurobindo Pharma Limited (VAI 2022-05-10), and Aurolife Pharma LLC (OAI 2021-12-07).
Alternative manufacturers AvPAK and Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. are also not on the shortage list, but their labels name no identifiable plant.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
